name: smoke-e3
description: Pipeline test of E3, never used for results: probe pass, then E3 for ML-DSA-44, ML-KEM-768, Falcon-512, SLH-DSA-SHA2-128f, HQC-1 and the five classical algorithms (every layer, including Go's standard library), and the null block, with tiny budgets (fast: 10 warm-up + 200 samples; slow: 1 s and at least 3 samples), 1 repetition.
